shared_elements: linear internal markings on the body/garment
justification: The main correspondence is only that both surfaces center an upright anthropomorphic figure with a head and torso articulated by linear details. The biggest difference is that A shows a profile, relatively naturalistic standing figure holding a long staff and wearing elaborate dress, while B shows a frontal, highly schematic block-like figure with geometric circular and band motifs on the body and no comparable held object or narrative pose.
